name: Particle Swarm
description: Boid swarm with anisotropic scattering: each particle reads its neighbours out of the state texture and applies cohesion and separation, so the field forms travelling flocks instead of N independent springs. Per-particle FFT bands drive turbulence and the attractor is spring-damped through extraBuffer[133..136]. Fixes a missing bounds guard and a degenerate Henyey-Greenstein term whose cosine was dotted against vec2(0,0), making the phase function a constant.

updatedParams.name: Spring Stiffness
updatedParams.description: Restoring force pulling each particle back to its home pixel.

updatedParams.name: Pointer Force
updatedParams.description: Attraction/repulsion strength around the cursor (0.5 is neutral).
